name: twobody_analytic
reason: ADR-002's goldens rule requires goldens against GMAT with a generator script and a recorded reason (docs/adr/002-dynamics-contract.md, Goldens). This golden is the documented exception docs/native-dynamics-plan.md milestone N1 calls for: a pure two-body (spherical-harmonic degree/order (0,0), point-mass only) arc has an exact closed-form solution (Kepler's equation solved by Newton iteration to machine precision, converted to Cartesian by the standard classical-elements transform), so it is proved against that analytic reference instead of a GMAT run -- GMAT is not needed to validate Kepler's equation. This is NOT the fifth amendment's one recorded exception (docs/adr/002-dynamics-contract.md, amendment 2026-09-05): that exception is about a covariance golden in a ROTATING frame, proved against a closed-form rotation built from GMAT's OWN reported R/Rdot because GMAT's OrbitErrorCovariance report was measured to omit the Rdot term -- a GMAT implementation gap that exception works around while still anchoring to GMAT's own numbers. This golden reads nothing GMAT ever produced: it is a first-principles ANALYTIC reference (Kepler's equation plus Vallado's COE2RV), not a GMAT reference with a documented gap, stated here plainly rather than folded quietly into the same kind of exception. Every other native force this plan adds still gets its golden against GMAT, per ADR-002's rule verbatim -- see this crate's own N1 report. Tolerance measured (not asserted): the native EarthGravityModel<IdentityRotation> at degree/order (0,0), stepped once with its default Dopri5 (rtol=atol=1e-12), reproduces the analytic final state to 6.83e-3 m / 7.36e-6 m/s (circular_like) and 8.36e-4 m / 3.19e-7 m/s (eccentric_e0p6) -- tolerance_m/tolerance_mps set just above the larger of the two measured residuals.
reference: closed-form two-body: Kepler's equation (Newton iteration, this script's solve_kepler) + classical-elements-to-Cartesian (Vallado COE2RV, this script's coe_to_cartesian)
